svg.text: Plug Puller — Flat 2-prong lamp plug (NEMA 1-15) · Small · two-sided plate
1:1 outline sheet — print at 100% scale / “Actual size”, never “fit to page”. Check the calibration square before trusting anything.
Small hand size · the tool is TWO plates
Customizer settings for this exact plate:
Velcro slots: none (plug too short for one)
Flat sides: straight, serrated V-edges grip the plug
1. Print at 100% and measure the calibration square — it must be exactly 50 × 50 mm.
2. Cut along the SOLID outline (both arms). Dashed lines are holes and slots.
3. Lay the cutout over your plug: the plug body sits between the serrated V-edges, the cord in the bottom channel.
4. The real tool is TWO of these plates zip-tied face to face around the plug — this sheet previews one.
5. Happy? Open the Customizer with the title-block settings and export your STL (the tool's quick start).
